components.title: RideTube
components.description: Video in the car: an unofficial client for YouTube. Your Home, Subscriptions and Watch later (signed in on the car), search, channels and chapters; the sound through the car's media player, the picture only while parked (a podcast view while driving). Needs the jap-ridetube-d tool.

components.title: RideTube service
components.description: The car side of RideTube, an unofficial client for YouTube: yt-dlp (from its official release, run in mgu-python) fetches as the daemon's own internet uid; search, feeds and thumbnails on the car (jap-node22); audio through the BMW MediaPlayer, video decoded by ytdec into the mgu-render video layer; TV device sign-in; controlled by the RideTube app over /run/jap-ridetube-d/ctl.sock

components.title: Node.js 22
components.description: Node.js 22 LTS for the background services of Moonride and RideTube (BMW's apps keep the system Node 8)
components.author: JustAnotherPU
